title: NVIDIA Vera: A Microarchitecture-Level Comparison with Grace, Turin, and Granite Rapids
description: Benchmark scripts, raw results, parsers and gnuplot figure scripts behind Table I and Figures 2-11 of the paper. Platforms: NVIDIA Grace, NVIDIA Vera (pre-release engineering sample), AMD EPYC 9R45, Intel Xeon 6975P-C. Benchmarks: STREAM, test-tlb, core-to-core latency, NAS Parallel Benchmarks, CloverLeaf, TeaLeaf, Neutral, miniBUDE, perf counters and six full applications.
